name: Maestro Barbershop

seo.title: Maestro Barbershop | Barbers in Luton
seo.description: Barbers on New Bedford Road, Luton. Skin fades, scissor cuts, beard trims and hot towel shaves by Hamza and Rupesh. Rated 4.7 on Google. Students 20% off on Tuesdays. Call 01582 966060.

hoursNote: Walk in any time. Call ahead if you are cutting it fine.

hero.alt: A high skin fade with a textured quiff, cut at Maestro Barbershop in Luton
hero.label: Barbers · New Bedford Road, Luton
hero.line:
Clean fades. Sharp beards.
Hot towel to finish.

intro.text: A small shop on New Bedford Road. Two barbers, no rush, and every cut finished properly.

services.label: The menu
services.heading: What we do.
services.intro: Tell us what you want, or ask what would suit you. Hamza and Rupesh have cut every head shape Luton has to offer.
services.pricingNote: Every price is quoted by your barber before we start, so you always know where you stand.

items.name: Skin fade
items.note: Taken down to the skin and blended clean. Lined up to finish.

items.name: Scissor cut
items.note: All scissors. Shaped to how you actually wear it.

items.name: Beard trim
items.note: Shaped, lined and edged. Hot towel included.

items.name: Kids' cut
items.note: Under 12. Patient, quick, and they leave looking sharp.

items.name: Hot towel shave
items.note: Face steam, hot towels, a close shave. Feels like a new man afterwards.

items.name: Cut & beard
items.note: Any cut on the list with a beard trim to match.

team.label: The barbers
team.heading: Two chairs. Two names people ask for.

members.name: Hamza
members.line: Regulars have been sitting in his chair since 2015. Professional, consistent, and the reason people drive across Luton.

members.name: Rupesh
members.line: Highly skilled and quick with it. In, cut properly, out. No wasted time.

offer.label: Student discount
offer.heading: Students. Tuesdays.
offer.body: Bring your student ID any Tuesday and take 20% off whatever you have done. Ten minutes' walk from the University of Bedfordshire, open until 7pm, so it fits around lectures.

about.label: About
about.heading: A proper barbershop on New Bedford Road.

photo.alt: Maestro Barbershop shopfront at 19 New Bedford Road, Luton, with the blue sign and the door open

paragraphs: Maestro is a small shop a few minutes' walk from the town centre. Hamza and Rupesh cut everything from a tight skin fade to a classic scissor cut, and finish beards the old way, with face steam and a hot towel.
Neat, clean and well lit, with a 4.7 rating from 66 Google reviews and regulars who have been coming for years. Come in, tell us what you want, and leave looking sharp.
